projects.title: Shower room refurbishment
projects.summary: A dated quadrant shower room taken back to the walls and floor and rebuilt as a warm, modern shower room. Not a simple refit: once the old tiles came off, the stud wall behind them needed replacing.
points: Old enclosure, tiles and fittings stripped out, and the floor opened to rework the waste and supply pipework
Failed studwork found behind the old tiles replaced with new studs, then boarded and waterproofed before tiling
A new return wall built to form the shower area, fitted with a slimline tray, brushed-brass framed sliding door and a thermostatic rainfall shower
Large-format porcelain to the floor and half-height walls, with a fluted wood vanity, new WC and brass towel rail

stages.label: After
stages.alt: The finished shower room with a brushed-brass framed shower, light porcelain tiles and a fluted wood vanity

projects.title: Steam cabin to walk-in shower
projects.summary: The customer no longer wanted his steam shower cabin and asked for something as close to a walk-in shower as possible, without the extra work of rebuilding the floor.
points: Steam cabin removed and replaced with a low black tray and a black-framed fixed glass screen, giving an open, walk-in feel
Removing the cabin left pipework exposed, so we built a false wall to hide it
We turned that false wall into a feature: dark porcelain, a concealed thermostatic valve and a large mirrored niche
Rainfall head on a black arm, plus a handset on a riser rail
Wall-hung black WC with a concealed cistern, floating vanity with a stone-effect top, wall-mounted black tap and a black towel radiator

stages.label: During

stages.label: After
stages.alt: The finished bathroom with a black-framed walk-in shower, wall-hung black WC and floating stone-topped vanity

projects.title: Loft shower room
projects.summary: A tired loft shower room under a sloping ceiling and skylight, taken back to the joists and rebuilt in marble-effect porcelain and brushed brass.
points: Old enclosure, tiles and fittings stripped out, and the floorboards lifted to rework the waste and pipework between the joists
Walls and floor rebuilt and fully tiled in large-format marble-effect porcelain, worked around the slope of the roof
A brushed-brass offset quadrant enclosure with a concealed valve, overhead shower and brass handset
Back-to-wall WC with a concealed cistern unit, new basin, brushed-brass towel rail and an illuminated round mirror
